verdict.rationale: Convex's docs say it 'doesn't need an opinionated authorization framework like RLS' and instead give developers the flexibility to build their own authorization framework. That is a developer building block, not a shipped row-level security or security-rules capability. Its authentication integrations (Convex Auth, Clerk, Auth0) cover identity rather than per-user data-access policies, so the evidence shows no product-provided RLS or rules feature for this applicable axis.
